thread:
noah: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need owners for the short and medium-term rollout changes. I'll call out the items; please pick one.

eva: Thanks. Can we also capture the recurring pattern in the ticket so we don't lose it? This was the 4th similar event.

noah: Agreed — pattern: low-entropy canary sampling + high per-shard concurrency -> downstream connection queuing -> 5xx spike. Immediate guardrails proposed below.

1) Emergency auto-rollback + scale-down-first flow
noah: Draft trigger: sustained p95 > 1.6s OR 5xx_ratio >= 0.75% for 120s. Flow: scale_down(concurrency*0.5) -> wait 30s -> rollback if still above threshold.

dmitri: I'll own the controller changes and tests. Target: 2 weeks (2025-03-18). Plan: RFC + integration sim.

2) Conservative prod defaults + explicit increase flow
noah: Prod default concurrency_limit = 25, non-prod = 120. Any increase requires a signed `increase_concurrency` flag and risk reviewer.

eva: I'll own the product policy and the signed increase UX. Target: 3 weeks (2025-03-25). Need legal review for enterprise opt-outs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary detected 2025-02-28T11:14Z — shards=4 concurrency=200 sample_rate=0.05

3) Sampling randomness + canary-skew telemetry
noah: Fix sticky routing by randomizing early-bucket hashing and emit `canary_shard_entropy`. Add a QC alert if entropy < 0.5.

dmitri: I'll do the routing change as a small hotfix and add the QC metric to the dashboard. Target for hotfix: 10 days (2025-03-08).

4) Per-flag blast-radius caps + per-tenant throttles
noah: Mechanic: per-flag active-user hard cap, per-shard ceiling, and tenant-throttle for graceful isolation.

eva: I'll produce a design doc with product/legal constraints and an opt-out path for AE customers. Target: 2025-03-25.

pm-bot: tracker: created CARD-ROLL-314 and scheduled weekly triage Fridays 09:30 PT

noah: Operationally: all items must be created as tickets on the `rollout-safety` board with owner + due date + postmortem link. I'll add the postmortem and create the board today.

dmitri: One question: should scale-down be tried only once? I suggest single scale-down attempt then rollback to avoid flapping. Will prototype ordering.

eva: Product asks for customer notification text for auto-rollback events. I'll draft copy and loop Legal.

noah: Recap owners/dates: controller+tests (dmitri) 2025-03-18, routing hotfix (dmitri) 2025-03-08, product+legal (eva) 2025-03-25. Weekly triage Fridays 09:30 PT. @dmitri @eva add blockers to CARD-ROLL-314.

dmitri: Ack, starting RFC.

eva: Ack, will schedule legal sync.

noah: If no objections I'll add these to the postmortem and close this thread.

eva: No objections.

dmitri: LGTM.

noah: Closing 44d — will ping when board/tickets are live.
